poll.source_locator: Q7 'Who did you vote for, or who will you vote for, in the election for Governor': Jocelyn Benson (Democrat) 52, John James (Republican) 46, Someone else 1, Not sure 0, I would not vote 0
poll.notes: Already-voted respondents report their vote; undecided asked to lean and leaners included (per question note). No sponsor named on the document (same 'ttw' series as the held Oct 6-12 Iowa report). MoE from header. Release date from Wikipedia citation and 270toWin listing (11/01); the PDF itself carries no release date. YouGov ttw series: NONPARTISAN per Max 2026-11-01 ruling (a firm polling on its own).

pollster.weighting_quote: The sample was weighted to gender, age, race, in-state geography (using the current Michigan voter list), and imputed education, party score, and 2024 presidential vote. Weights were computed using the method of raking. Likely voters are defined using a model that takes into account past vote, demographics, and self-reported likelihood to vote.
pollster.mode: online (text-message invitation from the Michigan registered-voter list to YouGov's web survey system)
